fitch.citation_text: Becker's 'Stamford Health has credit rating affirmed amid strong financial outlook' (Feb 8, 2023) references Fitch BBB+ affirmation with stable outlook coming out of FY2022. Fitch's prior downgrade A->BBB+ occurred April 2018. So Stamford was BBB+/Stable on 2022-12-31.

rating_actions_in_window.rationale: 'Rating is further supported by Stamford's dominant market position in a good primary service area with a very strong demographic profile' — Fitch.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Becker's Feb 8, 2023: 'Stamford Health has credit rating affirmed amid strong financial outlook' — Fitch reaffirmed BBB+ on Stamford's outstanding revenue bonds.

fitch.citation_text: Fitch BBB+/Stable in effect after Feb 2023 affirmation; no further Fitch action surfaced through 2025-03-31. Operating performance improved from -5.7% margin to 4.9% margin in FY2024 per Becker's reporting, consistent with the BBB+/Stable affirmation being maintained.

outcome_class_rationale: Fitch affirmed BBB+/Stable in Feb 2023 within the window; no subsequent rating actions or outlook revisions surfaced through 2025-03-31. No Moody's or S&P coverage. Outcome: AFFIRM_STABLE with operating performance materially improving during the window (operating margin -5.7% -> 4.9% FY2024).
